reason: The frozen reservation correctly requires adapter implementation before participant-value parsing, but ZIP central-directory metadata cannot reveal CSV column names. This amendment fixes a header-only schema step before the archive is complete so that column-name discovery cannot become an outcome-dependent protocol change.

prerequisites: the complete archive matches the registered byte size and MD5
the ZIP central-directory manifest has been written and hashed
authorized_header_only_step.eligible_members: only the single registered SAM questionnaire CSV and one representative clean-signal CSV selected deterministically from the central-directory manifest
authorized_header_only_step.selection_rule: choose the lexicographically first matching member under each registered branch before opening either member
authorized_header_only_step.read_boundary: read bytes only through the first line terminator, with an absolute maximum of 65536 uncompressed bytes per selected member
authorized_header_only_step.allowed_output: member path, raw header text, delimiter, encoding decision, normalized column names, byte count, and SHA-256 of the exact header bytes
forbidden_access: second line or any participant data row
EEG samples, timestamps, labels, quality values, or derived features
model fitting, endpoint construction, risk scores, actions, or outcomes
authorized_header_only_step.failure_policy: missing line termination within 65536 bytes, encrypted member, unsupported encoding, ambiguous delimiter, or absent registered branch is a schema failure; no additional member may be sampled

unchanged_contracts: SAM tasks and fixed one-to-nine thresholds
four registered channels and key-moment policy
counterfactual seeds, folds, models, doses, and material threshold
frozen risk model and DCS-OPCT v11 action gates
claim_boundary: This amendment authorizes schema names only and supplies no participant, structural-eligibility, endpoint, effectiveness, non-harm, replication, or safety evidence.
